title: Raise the fixed R439 scatter lower bound from 44 to 45 (no kappa)
body:
## Summary

Prove a new finite exclusion for PR2440's fixed R439 `ideal303` scatter interface. Column zero requires at least six taps at arbitrary target ports and cuts. Using the predecessor's other-column bounds as cited premises, the complete scatter lower bound rises from 44 to 45. The known upper bound remains 84.

```diff
- column-zero lower bound: 5
+ column-zero lower bound: 6
- complete scatter lower bound: 44
+ complete scatter lower bound: 45
```

Claim type: finite exclusion certificate with a written coverage proof. This is a historical scalar-interface side result, not an audit of the predecessor construction, a complete optimum, a paid-rank improvement or a new kappa. Produced by Nick Petalas.

Credit Sagar Thakrar / thakrarsagar PR2440 for the question, model and upper bound; Ross Richardson PR2407 for the column-zero construction; Sricharan Vagvala PR2356 for the suffix-response reduction; Charles Bethin PR2279 for split-ideal accounting; Sagar Thakrar PR1062/2115 and all retained R439 contributors listed in README. Meet-in-the-middle enumeration and linear superposition are classical. Exact source pins are retained; no predecessor executable is imported or replayed.

Advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19370159). The canonical base remained `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. Live claims, reservations, recent account work, main and merged/all-state searches were checked. The overlap snapshot covered 505 open PRs and 6,496 Discussion records with complete reported remote pagination. Sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

## Evidence

Before, PR2440 excluded at most four taps per column and explicitly left its complete 84-tap optimality open. After, a complete exact two-plus-three search excludes every at-most-five-tap representation of column zero in the relaxed dictionary, including all legal one-slot intervals.

- All 33,744 cut/port responses agree between backward suffix columns and a separately written literal injected-bit interpreter; 412 distinct responses remain.
- All 82,435 pair sums and 11,656,099 right subsets are covered; zero complementary sums occur. Exact integer equality decides membership.
- An independent full-subset oracle checks 128 small targets against 256 subsets: 125 accepted and three rejected. An actual-dictionary positive fixture and eleven invalid-domain/source-corruption controls pass.
- Both warning-strict normal/optimized CPython 3.12.15 commands pass with identical receipts. Direct local durations were 1.150 and 1.150 seconds; the full registered replay took 2.749 seconds, below the separate 120-second limits. These measure timeout headroom, not a speed improvement.
- Registered committed replay, source-history/byte/mode checks and the official seven-file export with declared-input coverage pass. Both direct modes pass in a read-only Git-free empty-PATH export, with all payload hashes unchanged. Three disposable code mutations reject wrong suffix orientation, omitted triples and incorrect XOR arithmetic.
- In-memory source compilation, function-size inspection and whitespace checks pass. An external Python linter was unavailable. Python allocation is documented under explicit finite bounds.

Reproduce from the repository root using this exact local interpreter or another CPython 3.12 installation:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/r439-column0-six-tap-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/r439-column0-six-tap-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-column0-six-tap-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/r439-column0-six-tap-floor --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers include `PASS_R439_COLUMN0_SIX_TAP_FLOOR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Stdout is a generated receipt bound to the exact source and every package file; no handwritten receipt is committed.

## Limitations

Only the frozen ideal303 order, kept gates {31,51,52}, independent retained columns and declared binary tap alphabet are covered. Source mixing, another order or target basis, additional operations and a changed consumer require a new argument. The total lower bound uses the credited predecessor's other-column bounds as premises. No six-tap attainer or exact optimum is supplied.

Native/parser admission, physical COPY/ERASE and ownership, hosting, precision/tapes, compiler closure and outer assembly remain open. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. All five selected framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

## Open next questions

Can an exact or structural method narrow the remaining 45 to 84 complete tap gap for this fixed order? First choose an unresolved column weight or a chronological interval constraint, preserving every independent source column. Higher-weight exclusions and a complete lifetime lower bound are missing. This result does not justify declaring 84 optimal.

## Related open work

- [PR3904](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3904) studies a dirty-helper K mismatch on PR967; it does not optimize this fixed PR1062 scatter dictionary.
- [PR3892](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3892) studies one R439 quartet frame cut and order control; this excludes tap representations on a different fixed deferred suffix.
- [PR3924](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3924) changes the seed-01 helper shear and middle map; the present bound applies only to the unchanged source input.
- [PR3891](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3891) prices an abstract helper-star boundary; this gives a fixed-word tap lower bound and supplies no H2-sem replacement.
- [PR2721](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2721) studies framed H2-sem transfer and target feedback; the present result fixes the target-only transport and independent retained sources.

No additional computations were run to compare those PRs, and no common numerical claim is asserted.

The completion refresh inspected all fifteen other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this fixed R439 scatter dictionary or reports a competing tap count. No additional scientific computations were run for that comparison.

## CI notes

At exact head `d6572b951eab243b64a88e9361259e62ebcc595a`, [run 41609227978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609227978) passed both [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609227978/job/125826635157) and [replay (research/r439-column0-six-tap-floor)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609227978/job/125829452799). The successful package job executes both registered normal/optimized commands and the source/input checks. Its log contains both scientific PASS receipts and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed.

The separate [Community T37-era finite circuits and bounds run 41609227868](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609227868), at the same head, failed its [finite job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609227868/job/125826632678). I read the completed job log: `PASS_R439_COPY_PATH_SHARING_BARRIER` precedes the traceback in `research/central-factor-packed/verify.py`, line 27, `admit_sources`, with the exact error:

```text
ValueError: Source pin mismatch: certificates/dyadic-central-factor.json
```

This is a pre-existing unrelated failure. The PR changes only six files under `research/r439-column0-six-tap-floor/`; it changes neither that certificate, the packed verifier nor the workflow. Prior pull-request logs were inspected directly:

- [PR4216](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4216), [finite run 39472993781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39472993781/job/118801618116), failed on October 20 with the identical certificate pin mismatch after its R439 check passed.
- The earlier `research/central-factor-pin-repair` pull-request [run 39482104398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39482104398/job/118833010763) also failed this workflow, but at a later distinct check: `ValueError: Changed hyperplane reviewed source: scripts/verify_hpe_lean_binding.py`. It is evidence of the earlier repair attempt and shared-workflow failure, not another instance of the identical pin exception.

All listed local checks passed. The registered package CI is successful; the repository-wide `finite` workflow remains red for the documented unrelated cause. No unrelated package was modified.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six new package files and one unchanged declared source input; shared code, predecessor credits and selected records are unchanged.
